name: Green Belt
tagline: Lean Six Sigma for healthcare practitioners.
worry: Is it the people, or the system?

end.paidLine: Full toolkit, exam and certificate, 12 months

beats.say: Every delay on your ward has a cause. The waiting room is full again. Antibiotics are late again. And everyone is working as hard as they can.
Is it the people, or the system? Where does the time really go? And if you fix it, can you prove it?
Breathe. Data tells you where. Judgement tells you what to do. The Green Belt toolkit has you.

beats.title: Define
beats.say: Thirty tools follow the DMAIC path, with a live statistical engine. Start with the problem, then brainstorm causes across all six categories, before anyone is blamed.

beats.title: Measure
beats.say: Map the journey from emergency department to ward, and watch the waiting appear. Find the bottleneck first, because speeding up one step can simply flood the next.

beats.title: Analyse
beats.say: Put the biggest causes first with a Pareto chart. Test your hypothesis, and see what the numbers really say.

beats.title: Improve
beats.say: Plot your change over time. In this example, door to antibiotic time fell from eighty six to fifty four minutes, and the toolkit flags the shift for you. Safety comes from resilient systems, not perfect people.

beats.title: Control
beats.say: Control limits tell you when a spike is real. In the red bead ward, every point sits inside the limits: the differences come from the system, so stop ranking people.

beats.title: Play
beats.say: Learn Lean Six Sigma by playing it, with two game worlds, eighteen tools and twenty one levels. And trace the history, from Ford’s line in nineteen thirteen to today’s wards.

beats.title: Certify
beats.say: Practise for nine certification blueprints, then earn your Certificate of Completion, with an ID badge and a verifiable code.
Thirty tools. Ten simulations. Over a thousand exam practice items.
The Green Belt toolkit is free to try. Full access is for twelve months, paid once. Fix the cause, and prove it.
